raw_text: AIS data confirms PLAN Type 055 DDG hull 103 (Yan'an) transiting Strait of Malacca westbound. Accompanied by Type 903A replenishment ship. Heading assessed as Indian Ocean. Indian Navy P-8I likely tasked for surveillance. This is the second Type 055 deployment to IOR this year.
clean_text: PLAN Type 055 destroyer Yan'an transiting Strait of Malacca westbound into Indian Ocean. Accompanied by replenishment ship. Second Type 055 IOR deployment this year.
